def orient(series, name):
    return -series.copy() if name in LOWER_IS_WORSE else series.copy()

def onset_3sigma(series, name):
    s = orient(series, name)
    base, sigma = s[0], np.std(s)
    if sigma < 1e-12: return None
    thresh = base + 3 * sigma
    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        if s[i] > thresh: return i
    return None

series = {}
for m in CANARIES + DOWNSTREAMS:
    series[m] = np.array([d[m] for d in data])
